title: Wedding Norm Break Budget Pact
oneLiner: Couples convert family pressure, guest travel costs, and production creep into a shared low-drama wedding budget pact.
theme: 자산 방어 / 외로움 / 역전 - resisting wedding production pressure while preserving relationships.
targetUser: Gen Z couples, Korea-based couples, and families trying to plan smaller weddings without triggering social or parent conflict.
keyUX: Couple ranks what matters, enters family asks, guest travel burden, DIY labor, and venue quotes; the app creates a norm-breaking budget pact and conversation scripts.
requiredUISections: Wedding pressure header showing comfort budget, family asks, and guest burden
Tradition breaker cards for venue, meal, dress, photos, gifts, and afterparty
Guest travel and cash strain map
Budget pact split view for couple, parents, and guests
sourceSignals: S5 - NY Post, Gen Z calls modern weddings expensive and overproduced: https://nypost.com/2026/06/18/lifestyle/the-no-1-word-gen-z-use-to-describe-modern-weddings/
S6 - Reddit r/Living_in_Korea, wedding planning from scratch in Korea: https://www.reddit.com/r/Living_in_Korea/comments/1shb8xm/has_anyone_tried_wedding_planning_from_scratch_in/
stitchPrompt: Build a production-grade web app prototype called "Wedding Norm Break Budget Pact" for couples who want a meaningful wedding without expensive production pressure. The first screen must be a working budget-pact workspace with a wedding pressure header, tradition breaker cards, guest travel and cash strain map, DIY labor reality calculator, family conversation script composer, couple-parent budget pact split view, and shareable ceremony values card. Use realistic sample data: 70 guests, Korea evening reception idea, family request for a standard hall, $18,000 comfort budget, $33,000 comparable venue quote, two guests flying in, and one DIY-heavy plan. Design direction: use the calm-consumer profile with reassuring spacing, warm but not beige-heavy surfaces, plain-language scripts, and gentle accountability states for family tradeoffs. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
